about.title: About Me & Journey
about.subtitle: In plain terms: I build websites, mobile apps, and digital systems. Technically: I am a Full Stack & Mobile Software Engineer.
about.bio: I am a Software Engineer — in practice, that means I create everything from institutional websites and online stores to mobile apps (iOS & Android) and full digital systems for businesses. I have hands-on experience with large-scale, high-traffic products like the Poder360 Elections 2024 live results dashboard, and I am also the founder of eScriptura, a SaaS management system for churches. Beyond coding, I enjoy guitar 🎸, gaming 🎮, and continuous learning.

experiences.summary: Engineering and maintaining the digital systems and platforms powering one of Brazil's leading political journalism portals.
highlights: Built the Elections 2024 special project: a live vote-counting dashboard accessed by thousands of Brazilians on election night.
Developed high-performance websites and web platforms using React and Next.js — systems that stay fast even under heavy simultaneous traffic.
Built and maintained APIs (the 'engine' behind websites) using Node.js, Express, NestJS, and Fastify.
Created automated scripts that collect and process data on their own (web scraping and ETL pipelines) using Python and Node.js.
Automated dynamic image and content generation for journalistic distribution.
Maintained and customized WordPress-based websites and integrations.

experiences.summary: Worked across the full lifecycle of websites, mobile apps, and digital systems — from idea to live production.
highlights: Built backend systems and APIs (the engine that makes websites and apps work) in PHP, Laravel, Node.js, and NestJS.
Developed responsive, modern web interfaces using React.
Built cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native.
Set up automated deployment pipelines with Docker and CI/CD — ensuring systems go live reliably.

experiences.summary: Delivered custom web systems for real clients at IFPB's junior enterprise, bridging business needs with technical execution.
highlights: Built custom websites and web systems for real clients using React, Node.js, and Vite.
Gathered client requirements and translated them into technical and commercial proposals.
Worked in Agile sprints with Git version control for team collaboration.

experiences.summary: Provided IT support and built digital solutions to modernize public services for a municipal government.
highlights: Designed, built, and deployed urnaSIM: a digital electronic voting system — like Brazil's TSE voting machines, but for student elections in public schools.
Provided hardware, network, and software support for municipal administration systems.

projects.title: eScriptura — EBD Management SaaS
projects.description: A SaaS (subscription-based digital system) for modernizing Sunday Bible School (EBD) management at churches. It lets church leaders track student enrollment, attendance, generate reports, and manage finances — all online, paperless. Built with Next.js and Firebase.

projects.title: Grão Roxo Coffee Mobile App
projects.description: Mobile app (for smartphones) developed voluntarily for Café Grão Roxo. Served as Tech Lead, coordinating the dev team, aligning with the business owners, designing the user experience, and architecting the React Native app.

projects.title: Elections 2024 Dashboard — Poder360
projects.description: Live election results website for Brazil's 2024 elections, built for Poder360 — one of Brazil's largest political journalism portals. Engineered for extreme speed and high availability, even with thousands of simultaneous users.

projects.title: urnaSIM — Electronic Voting System
projects.description: A digital electronic voting system — similar to Brazil's official TSE voting machines, but designed for student elections in public schools. Built from scratch with Node.js and MongoDB for transparent and educational elections.

projects.title: semiopop — Nursing Mobile App
projects.description: Mobile app created at IFPB to digitize standard operating procedures (SOPs) — essentially turning printed clinical manuals into interactive smartphone screens — for Nursing students and instructors.

projects.title: GeoJuazeiro School Portal
projects.description: Institutional website built for GeoJuazeiro school in Bahia, with a responsive design (works great on both mobile and desktop) and a content management system the school team can use without coding.

projects.title: Brasil Sun Landing Page
projects.description: Sales landing page for a solar energy company, optimized to rank well on Google (SEO) and load fast — driving more customer conversions.
